messages.subject: newbie help on tutorial
parts:
I'm trying to walk through the shiny tutorial of building an app on a Windows machine.  When I try to "runApp" I receive the following:

runApp("~/shinyapp")
Warning in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  cannot open file 'C:/Users/dsamhat/Documents/shinyapp/server.R': Permission denied
Error in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) : 
  cannot open the connection

Any help would be appreciated. Thanks.

messages.author: 3e06428f200265c8
messages.subject: Re: newbie help on tutorial
parts:
Have you tried changing your working directory to the location of your app and doing runApp() from there?  

Does the file c:/users/dsamhat/documents/shinyapp/server.R exist?  And do you have the appropriate permissions for it?

robbie
